new_hypothesis_and_wrong_rule: Pair a true unit horizontal/vertical L in the empty grid with the unit L adjacent to BC. Proposed error assigns the full1x1 cell area1 to triangle ABC via its shared diagonal BC, forgetting that the equivalent adjacent half-cell triangle has area1/2.
